infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DriveSense uses your location during a trip to record route, speed, heading, and live driving telemetry.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: DriveSense keeps recording your route while the app is in the background so a trip is not cut short when you switch apps or lock your phone.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: DriveSense uses motion sensors to show how smoothly you are driving and to measure G-force.
